name: Markus sells Heroic Dungeon items for every slot at live prices, and the Mark of Triumph items at live prices
contract: Markus (1414503) opens the Mark of Triumph list 9414500 from his first gossip option and a slot menu from his second; each slot opens 9414500 + slot. Live Markus lists Heroic Dungeon helms on six pages (52 items, 60 Marks each) and necks on three (21, 35 Marks each). Before this change Head, Neck, Chest, Wrists, Gloves, Rings and Trinkets were empty, so the slot menu had 9 entries plus Back, and every Heroic item cost 30. Prices by slot: head, shoulders, chest, pants 60; neck, rings, trinkets 35; back, wrists, gloves, belt, boots 30; main hand, off hand 40; two-hand, ranged 80. The Mark of Triumph page shows Centurion's Barbute for 85, Spellbound Demonic Rune for 80, Aegis of Defense for 65 and Lunar Splinter for 70; we sold them for 80, 60, 55 and 45. Menu icons are 48 px, raised 3 px to cover the gossip icon, and the two first options are epic purple.

steps.label: Speak to Markus
The Mark of Triumph option has a 48 px icon and epic purple text
Open the Mark of Triumph items
The Mark of Triumph list has its 36 items
DISCRIMINATING: Centurion's Barbute costs 85 Marks
DISCRIMINATING: Spellbound Demonic Rune costs 80 Marks
DISCRIMINATING: Aegis of Defense costs 65 Marks
DISCRIMINATING: Lunar Splinter costs 70 Marks
Speak to Markus again
Open the Heroic Dungeon Items slot menu
DISCRIMINATING: all 16 slots are offered, plus Back
The first slot is Head, with a 48 px icon
Open the Head list
DISCRIMINATING: 52 Heroic Dungeon helms, six pages as on live
DISCRIMINATING: Eye of Rend, a helm, costs 60 Marks
Speak to Markus for the necks
Open the slot menu again
Open the Neck list
DISCRIMINATING: 21 Heroic Dungeon necks, three pages as on live
DISCRIMINATING: Emberfury Talisman costs 35 Marks
Speak to Markus for the trinkets
Open the slot menu once more
Open the Trinkets list
DISCRIMINATING: Hand of Justice is on the Trinkets list for 35 Marks
